entries.title: Stylised Three-Pad Waterlily Planting Module
entries.description: One original static stylised shallow-water planting module with three broad individually notched thick leaf pads, three unequal bent slender petioles, and one deliberately rectangular block-shaped shared basal root mass. Every leaf-to-petiole and petiole-to-rhizome junction shares the entire real mesh boundary: no capped overlapping pieces, floating pads or unconnected internal solids. Each pad has a true open radial cleft, faceted upper relief and a continuous finite-thickness perimeter and underside. All geometry belongs to one closed connected editable mesh and one whole prop; leaves, stalks, colour zones and formats are not separate assets. Four constant opaque matte PBR tones with no texture. Native metres and Z up, front -Y, horizontally centred ground origin at the complete rhizome sole. No old mangrove, reed, sedge, fern, palm, produce, seaweed or flower-box geometry reused, recoloured, rescaled or imported. An illustrative waterlily-like form, without a flower or scientific species, botany, habitat, ecology, planting, buoyancy, growth, wind, animation, collision, navigation, load, safety or physical-performance claim. The block-shaped basal form is an intentionally simplified planting-module base; it is not a naturalistic botanical root reconstruction. No water plane, ground island, soil, pot, other plant, variant or scene.

entries.title: Open Flanged Elbow Pipe Display
entries.description: One original static steam-workshop pipe display: a single continuous thick-walled octagonal elbow turns through ninety degrees from a horizontal open flange to an upward open flange, held on two separate rectangular pedestals and a grounded base. Both mouths have complete integral broad flange lips and the entire bent bore is genuinely empty, including both external egresses. The flange and body surfaces form one connected closed material shell; flanges are solid rings without bolt holes, fasteners or a mating-pipe claim. Four editable closed connected material meshes, four constant opaque untextured PBR materials. One prop and zero scenes. Metres are game-space coordinates, native Z up, front -Y, footprint-centred ground origin. All product geometry is original numeric construction. No reuse, recolour or renaming of the prior gear study kit, boiler, piston, hydrant, vessel outlet or appliance wand. Fixed visual form only: no fluid flow, steam, pressure, heat, sealing, flange standard, installation fit, manufacture, structural load, stability, motion or safety capability. Not real equipment construction or operating guidance. No valve, external pipe system, texture, text, animation or scene.

entries.title: Festival Performer Side-Stage Preparation
entries.description: One static festival performer side-stage scene with a western empty low platform, complete fixed opaque wing screen dividing the stage from eastern ground-level instrument preparation, a separate southern holding bench and eastern empty fabric-cart service pocket. Seven unchanged published asset IDs appear as seven full unit-scale rigid instances with every original mesh, hierarchy, oriented triangle and solid PBR retained. A complete twin-post festoon marks the rear edge. One closed scene-only floor supports every entire original grounded bottom patch. Ten connected finite empty standing reference volumes link the south entrance, screen-end bypass, platform ground approach, guitar and score preparation, holding aisle and cart approach. One scene and zero new independent models. Static appearance only: no stage access or step traversal, sound, performance animation, rehearsal or event operations, electrical connection, fabric contents, wardrobe workflow, navigation, ergonomics, accessibility, building code, structural load, stability, installation or safety certification.

entries.title: Baffled Twin-Arch Ruin Path
entries.description: Two complete perpendicular offset portals are connected by a finite supported dogleg route around the west end of a complete breached wall. A single complete column marks a northern side viewing pocket. The breach retains its full lower wall and is not treated as an entrance. One scene, zero independent models, no old geometry alterations; static finite empty volumes only, no continuous navigation, accessibility, archaeology, structural, stability or safety claim. Four unit-scale rigid placements retain every original mesh, hierarchy, full oriented triangle, and opaque solid PBR: two intact thirteen-voussoir stone arches, one complete deep-breached masonry wall, and one whole fluted column. Six connected whole empty route and viewing volumes are checked against all actual old meshes and are entirely supported by one scene-only ground slab. The wall creates a south approach, west bypass and north return before the east-facing exit; neither arch is a variant or new model. The .06m outer base step needs external placement. No props, doors, rubble, vegetation, new standalone model or historical reconstruction.
